summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Property Tracking feature (TaxTrack AU). All 7 backend pytest tests pass. All frontend flows verified via Playwright. Feature is fully functional.
seed_data_creation: Used existing test property prop_821cccd7105e. Created and cleaned up test transactions during testing. Also created and cleaned up a test property (99 Test St, Melbourne) - this property remains in DB from earlier backend test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Property Tracking feature fully tested and working. All data-testid attributes present and functional. Non-premium gate returns 403 from backend and shows upgrade page in frontend. Div 43 depreciation calculates correctly (320000 * 0.025 = 8000). Note: a leftover 'TEST_77 Sample Rd' property may exist in MongoDB from test runs - can be cleaned up. The Melbourne property '99 Test St' from the test run also exists.
